name: Google Docs
description: Create professionally formatted Google Docs from Markdown or HTML, read docs with paginated/targeted reads for large documents, delete sections/ranges, use templates, manage page formatting (margins, headers, footers), make in-place suggestion edits (highlighted for human review), and add, list, resolve, or delete review comments.

when_to_use: When a task involves creating formatted docs from Markdown or HTML, editing text ranges or styles programmatically without reflowing the whole body, exporting/importing .docx files, suggesting in-place edits for human review, or adding, listing, resolving, and deleting comments on Google Docs.
